lighthouse-basement.title: Lighthouse hidden basement: levers and opening conditions
lighthouse-basement.html:
The yellow lever is assigned to the hidden basement. Try interacting with it first; pulling it alone is not yet confirmed to open the doors.

The three levers

Blue: lighthouse. Green: furnace. Yellow: basement. Both lighthouse variants use this mapping.

What if the lighthouse is not ready?

The game includes a lighthouse-not-ready message. It is not yet clear whether this requires waiting or operating other levers. The blue → green → yellow order has not been verified.

Confirmed basement configuration

The basement’s facilities include four runes, four doors, four flames, loot spawn points and a radiation area. Rune lighting and flames going out involve timers, but their starting points, resets and role in opening the doors are unknown.

Still unverified

The full lever sequence, required lit runes, waiting time, door-open duration and radiation conditions remain unconfirmed. The available evidence is insufficient for guaranteed opening instructions.

military-base-keycard.title: Military base keycard: how to obtain it
military-base-keycard.html:
Visit the military base (Citadel), defeat its guards and check their dropped loot. A keycard may drop; it cannot be crafted.

Local resources link the easy, medium and hard guard loot tables to the military base keycard. A successful selection of this loot entry produces one card. A kill does not guarantee a drop.

The tables also use selection and quantity rules. The final drop rate is unconfirmed, and no guard tier can yet be declared the best source.

According to the official guide, use the card at the access terminal on the roof of the central radar building. It is consumed to call an airdrop, notifying nearby players. The radar then enters a cooldown.

plane-crash-keycard.title: Plane crash keycard: acquisition clues and open questions
plane-crash-keycard.html:
The relevant item is the Captain Keycard. It cannot be crafted and appears in a plane-specific loot table. The exact container and pickup location remain unconfirmed.

Confirmed clues

The Captain Keycard is included among plane-related loot, with one card awarded when it appears. The actual container is still unknown; not every plane crate is confirmed to contain one.

Where should you look?

The available clues point to loot boxes associated with keys and tools around the crash site. The exact box, location and route have not been confirmed.

Where is the card used?

There is a card reader at the crash site. The card’s description explicitly says it does not work inside the cockpit. The correct reader and the door it opens still need verification.

Still unconfirmed

The actual container, location, respawn conditions, drop rate and door-opening steps need further investigation or in-game verification. A guaranteed route to obtain the card is not yet available.
